definitions.explanation: The overall visual appearance of an area, especially as shaped by natural features, architecture, and urban planning. Often used in contexts involving preservation and regulation of the visual environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{景観|けいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。

{景観|けいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Building height is restricted to preserve the landscape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧な{景観|けいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{損|そこ}なわない→損なう：18061_sokonau⟧よう、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられている→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: Strict standards have been established for new construction so as not to spoil the historical landscape.

notes:
USAGE:
More formal and specific than ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧ (scenery). {景観|けいかん} emphasizes the overall visual character of an area, especially in the context of urban planning, architecture, and environmental protection. Japan has a {景観法|けいかんほう} (Landscape Act) that regulates development to preserve scenic areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {景観|けいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect the landscape
- {景観|けいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{損|そこ}なう→損なう：18061_sokonau⟧: to spoil the landscape
- {景観|けいかん}⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧: landscape ordinance
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{景観|けいかん}: natural landscape
- ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧{景観|けいかん}: urban landscape

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: scenery, view (everyday, general)
- ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧: scenery, landscape (literary, often visual art)
- ⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧: view (from a specific vantage point)
